label: GO step, choosing a1 after an unrewarded trial, early in the episode
explanation: Fires only at GO (never at D1 or D2), almost only when the agent is choosing a1 (model_act==1 gets 94% of the mass; a2 choices get about 6%). Within a1 choices it is much stronger after an unrewarded previous trial (prev_reward==0 has 82% of the mass) and when the episode is early: the rate falls steadily with ep_trial and is zero after trial ~70. It also tracks moderate value (7.7-8.1). GO & a1 alone gives recall 0.90 but precision 0.16. Adding prev_reward==0 & ep_trial<50 gives dev P 0.67 / R 0.60 / F1 0.63, mass recall 0.74, and covers 90% of the top activation quartile. Most misses are weaker a1 GOs after a reward that follow a recent unrewarded trial; adding (reward two trials back == 0) as an alternative raises mass recall to 0.83 at F1 0.66. Uses only observed variables plus the upcoming choice of the agent itself.
